Hi Alicia / Samir —

Thanks again for carving out time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and the open items we promised to follow up on:

- Decision criteria: primary focus is reliability under burst traffic and a predictable per-token cost profile; you mentioned retention policy impact and security attestations (SOC2).
- Procurement asks: confirm whether a PO is required up front or only at contract signature; who in AP receives invoices; whether Vela needs a vendor intake form + W-9.
- Timeline: you tentatively indicated vendor onboarding + billing setup would take ~2–4 weeks after intake is complete.

Next steps (proposed):
1) We attach a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that outlines onboarding tasks (attached: redwood-MAP-Vela-20261215.pdf). Can you confirm owners for the MAP items?
2) Rafael to provide W-9 and standard SOW for internal review (attached: W9_Redwood.pdf).
3) Align procurement + AP on a 30-min sync to confirm PO/invoice routing and required fields.

Questions for you: can you confirm the AP email where invoices should be sent, and clarify whether we should submit a vendor intake before sending the SOW?

I put Marissa and Irene on Cc — Marissa will own commercial ops and Irene will shadow the security evidence flow for the SOC2 checklist.

Thanks,

Thanks Rafael — great recap. A few clarifications from procurement/AP side: 

- Yes, we require a PO for any paid engagement. PO is generated once vendor intake + commercial terms (SOW) are approved.
- Please send invoices to billing@velahealth.com; include our remit address and attach the signed SOW on the invoice submission.
- We do require a completed vendor intake form — I attached our intake URL below. The form asks for tax ID, W-9, bank remit instructions, and contact for contract questions.
- For security: our InfoSec team will run a light SOC2/pen-test intake next week; Irene, if you can share the SOC2 type/attestation we have that will speed things up.

Tentative owners: Samir (Procurement) will own vendor intake + PO generation; Alicia (AP) owns invoice processing; legal looped on commercial terms after we receive SOW.

Link: https://velahealth.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/Finance/pages/Vendor+Intake+Form

If you can return the completed intake + signed SOW by Tuesday (12/21) we can aim for PO issuance the following week.

Best,
Alicia Torres
Director, Accounts Payable | Vela Health

Confirmed — billing@velahealth.com is correct.

A couple quick notes from procurement:
- We require a completed vendor intake + signed SOW before a PO is issued. Typical intake processing time is 2–3 business days once we have a completed form and W-9; PO issuance typically occurs within 5 business days after intake approval, so plan ~1–3 weeks total depending on legal review.
- Please include remit address and our vendor code field (VND-xxxxx) on the invoice.
- We do not require insurance docs for this engagement level, but if legal requests later we will let you know.

I'll watch for the DocuSign link and the intake submission. If you can send the invoice to billing@velahealth.com when the SOW is signed, we'll queue it for payment.
